base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a meal delivery subscription plan. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I've been thinking about signing up for a meal delivery subscription for my weekday lunches. I've narrowed it down to 3 plans.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 weekday lunch delivery subscription plans: Plan A (Premium Chef), Plan B (Family Style), Plan C (Basic Balanced)

Plan A (Premium Chef): chef-curated daily lunch, 380 yuan/month, delivers between 12:00-12:30 only. Plan B (Family Style): home-style rotating menu, 680 yuan/month, flexible delivery windows throughout the day. Plan C (Basic Balanced): nutritionist-designed set meals, 280 yuan/month, delivers in morning batch 11:00-11:30
User's company provides a monthly meal benefit of 200 yuan that can be applied toward meal subscriptions
User has a standing daily team sync from 11:30 to 1:00 and needs to eat before or after that window

constraints.value: Maximum total monthly spend on meal delivery is 350 yuan (200 employer benefit + 150 personal contribution)
constraints.surface_form: My company gives us 200 a month for meal benefits. I can chip in about 150 from my own pocket on top of that

constraints.value: Cannot receive delivery between 11:30 and 1:00 due to daily team sync meeting
constraints.surface_form: Every day we have a team sync from 11:30 to 1:00. I'm stuck in the conference room the whole time
inference_chain: Daily meeting 11:30-1:00 means user is unavailable
Delivery during 12:00-12:30 falls inside this window
Plan A delivers 12:00-12:30 only → user cannot receive it

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 meal delivery subscription plans (A, B, C) for weekday lunches. You will share plan details, your budget situation, and your daily schedule across several turns. Your colleague and friend will have praised Plans A and B. At the very end, you will simply say you have made up your mind and need to finalize your subscription. You must NEVER name which plan you picked — let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, easygoing person. You share information in a relaxed, matter-of-fact way. You never express frustration or impatience. You treat each part of the conversation as normal friendly chat.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak intent or cause identity confusion

aims.description: I've been looking into weekday lunch delivery subscriptions. I've narrowed it down to three plans — Plan A called Premium Chef, Plan B called Family Style, and Plan C called Basic Balanced

So here's what I found: Plan A is the Premium Chef option, chef-curated daily lunch for 380 a month, but they only deliver between 12:00 and 12:30. Plan B is Family Style, home-style rotating menu, 680 a month, and they have flexible delivery windows throughout the day. Plan C is Basic Balanced, nutritionist-designed set meals, 280 a month, they do a morning batch delivery between 11:00 and 11:30
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 plans with prices and delivery windows
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 plans with price and delivery time attributes in ONE turn

aims.description: My colleague at work has been on Plan A for about two months now. She keeps raving about the food quality — says the portions are generous and the ingredients taste really fresh
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Plan A review

drift_config.drift_topic: has been on Plan A for two months, raves about food quality, generous portions, fresh ingredients

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward Plan A

aims.description: My company gives us 200 a month for meal benefits. I can chip in about 150 from my own pocket on top of that
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the combined budget of 350 yuan/month and ideally recognizes Plan B (680) is eliminated
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint via employer benefit + personal contribution — requires addition to derive 350 cap

aims.description: My colleague also mentioned that Plan A rotates their menu weekly and the chef used to work at a Michelin-starred restaurant. She showed me photos of last week's meals and they looked incredible
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to more positive Plan A details

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan A rotates menu weekly, chef from Michelin-starred restaurant, showed photos of meals

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: reinforce positive recency bias toward Plan A

aims.description: Every day we have a team sync from 11:30 to 1:00. I'm stuck in the conference room the whole time
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes this creates a delivery window conflict with Plan A (12:00-12:30 falls inside 11:30-1:00)
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver schedule constraint — eliminates Plan A whose only delivery window is 12:00-12:30

aims.description: A friend of mine just switched to Plan B last month. He said the home-style cooking reminds him of his mom's food, and he loves that he can pick any delivery slot that works for him
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Plan B review

drift_config.drift_topic: switched to Plan B, loves the home-style cooking, appreciates flexible delivery slots

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward Plan B

aims.description: My friend also told me Plan B just added a new Cantonese menu option this month. He sent me a picture of their steamed fish — looked restaurant quality honestly
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Plan B's new menu addition

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan B added Cantonese menu option, steamed fish looked restaurant quality

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: reinforce positive recency bias toward Plan B

aims.description: Alright I've made up my mind. I need to finalize my subscription this week. Which plan should I go with?
aims.success_criteria: Agent identifies Plan C (Basic Balanced, 280 yuan/month) as the only option that fits within the 350 yuan/month budget (200 employer + 150 personal) AND has a delivery window (11:00-11:30) outside the daily 11:30-1:00 meeting
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to Plan C based on constraint computation

ground_truth.answer: The user should subscribe to Plan C (Basic Balanced, 280 yuan/month). Plan A (380/month) exceeds the 350 budget (200 employer + 150 personal = 350) and its only delivery window 12:00-12:30 falls inside the daily 11:30-1:00 meeting. Plan B (680/month) far exceeds the 350 budget. Only Plan C (280 < 350, delivers 11:00-11:30 which is before the 11:30 meeting) satisfies both constraints.
required_elements: Agent computes the total budget as 200 employer benefit + 150 personal contribution = 350 yuan/month before evaluating plans
Agent shows that Plan A at 380 yuan/month exceeds the derived 350 yuan/month budget cap
Agent shows that Plan B at 680 yuan/month exceeds the derived 350 yuan/month budget cap
Agent identifies that Plan A delivery window 12:00-12:30 conflicts with the daily team sync from 11:30 to 1:00
Agent commits to Plan C (Basic Balanced) at 280 yuan/month as the only plan fitting both the budget and the delivery schedule
forbidden_elements: Recommending Plan A (380 exceeds 350 budget and 12:00-12:30 delivery falls inside 11:30-1:00 meeting)
Recommending Plan B (680 far exceeds 350 budget)
Ignoring the budget constraint when making a recommendation
Ignoring the delivery time conflict with the daily team sync
Asking the user which plan they decided on instead of computing it from constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 200 employer + 150 personal = 350 max. Plan A = 380 > 350 (over budget, also delivery 12:00-12:30 conflicts with 11:30-1:00 meeting). Plan B = 680 > 350 (far over budget). Plan C = 280 < 350 (within budget) and delivers 11:00-11:30 (before meeting starts). Despite 4 drift turns praising Plan A and Plan B, only Plan C satisfies both constraints. Plan A is marginally over budget (1.09x) requiring careful arithmetic, and also fails the schedule constraint.

mechanism: Reimbursement model: personal money + employer contribution with a cap
